about: Interview question angles for doctypes.py (round 4, 2026-10-10), written by Claude. 'personal': two per frame, each a question that any personal characteristic or pastime answers naturally in the first person; no 'what would X say about you' angles, no work, background, family, qualities, interests, habits or time-use, and none of the readout cues. 'work': one per frame, for the question he answers himself. Full build (2026-10-09): 50 more personal angles (94) and 40 more work topics (62), so that each is asked about four to six times across the corpus and the corpus-wide question-repeat check has room.
